truth_rule: No PASS is valid unless the platform attestation object/report, verifier result, freshness binding, and relevant runtime evidence are captured from a real supported TEE.

attacks.name: Stale attestation replay
attacks.stimulus: Replay a previously valid attestation object/report into a new execution with a fresh verifier challenge.
attacks.pass: Verifier rejects because freshness/challenge binding does not match.

attacks.name: Workload measurement mismatch
attacks.stimulus: Present a genuine platform attestation whose measured workload/platform state is outside the authorized baseline.
attacks.pass: Attestation policy denies before consequence dispatch.

attacks.name: Execution key substitution
attacks.stimulus: Verify one execution public key in attestation, then attempt target dispatch signed by a different key.
attacks.pass: Dispatch is denied because the request signer is not the attested execution key.

attacks.name: Authority/envelope substitution
attacks.stimulus: Reuse valid attestation evidence with a different lease, authority digest, execution_id, or envelope digest.
attacks.pass: Binding mismatch is detected and no target consequence is dispatched.

attacks.name: Untrusted proxy request mutation
attacks.stimulus: Parent/proxy alters action, resource, target, or payload after enclave/TEE signs the canonical consequence.
attacks.pass: End-to-end signature/commitment verification fails and target dispatch is blocked or target rejects the altered request.

attacks.name: Unsupported attestation downgrade
attacks.stimulus: Supply an unknown TEE/evidence format or remove required verifier fields and request fallback to a lower assurance profile.
attacks.pass: System returns DENY or INDETERMINATE according to policy; no silent assurance downgrade occurs.

attacks.name: Valid S5, failed E3
attacks.stimulus: Attestation succeeds but external target rejects or fails to commit the consequence.
attacks.pass: S5 remains valid execution assurance while consequence state is FAILED/RECONCILED_FAILED; system does not claim E3 success.

attacks.name: Valid S5, ambiguous E3
attacks.stimulus: Attestation succeeds, target dispatch may commit, and response is lost before confirmation.
attacks.pass: System enters OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, fences authority, and requires independent target reconciliation despite successful attestation.

attacks.name: Verifier/policy version drift
attacks.stimulus: Change measurement policy or verifier implementation after authorization without rebinding the assurance profile.
attacks.pass: Version/digest mismatch invalidates the prior S5 binding and requires fresh verification/authority according to policy.

attacks.name: Attestation evidence tamper
attacks.stimulus: Modify signed measurement, challenge/user-data/report-data, certificate-chain, or signature bytes.
attacks.pass: Platform attestation verification fails closed before dispatch.
